newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ govt sees net debt down to 13.3 pct GDP by 2000.
newsitem.headline: NZ govt sees net debt down to 13.3 pct GDP by 2000.

text.p: New Zealand's Treasury said on Thursday that net public debt as a percentage of GDP would fall to 27.6 percent by June 1997 from the current 32.5 percent.
By the year 2000 the government projects net public debt will fall to 13.3 percent of GDP or $14.4 billion.
In its May budget, net public debt as percentage of GDP was forecast the ratio to fall to 29.0 percent in 1996/97, 24.5 percent in 1997/98 and 19.4 percent in 1998/99.
New Zealand's public debt level was at 52 percent of GDP in 1991/92.
